source:
@@U00173@@
We on the breast of earth
Lost in frustrating night;
Lord God, we languish
In pain and annoy;
Lord, in our anguish
Lamenting Your Joy.

@@U00175@@
From the lap of corruption,
Christ has ascended!
Rejoice, now, the fetters
That bound Him are rended!
Praise Him unceasingly,
Show love increasingly,
Giving alms brotherly,
Break bread in sanctity,
Spread the Word wanderingly
To all who will hear,
The Master is near you,
The Master is here!

@@U00177@@
A variety of strollers come from the city.

@@U00179@@
Where’re you off to?

@@U00181@@
Hunter's Lodge.

@@U00183@@
We'll be out at the Mill.

@@U00185@@
It’s livelier out at the River Inn.

@@U00187@@
Ah, but what an ugly walk.
translation:
@@U00173@@
我们在大地的胸怀
迷失在令人沮丧的夜晚；
主神，我们憔悴
在痛苦和烦恼中；
主啊，在我们的痛苦中
哀叹你的喜悦。

@@U00175@@
从腐败的怀抱中，
基督已经升天了！
欢喜吧，现在，束缚
束缚他的束缚被撕裂了！
不住地赞美他，
秀恩爱越来越多，
兄弟间施舍，
神圣地擘开面包，
四处传播福音
致所有愿意听的人，
师父就在你身边，
师父来了！

@@U00177@@
各种各样的婴儿车来自城市。

@@U00179@@
你要去哪里？

@@U00181@@
猎人的小屋。

@@U00183@@
我们会去磨坊。

@@U00185@@
River Inn 更热闹。

@@U00187@@
啊，但是走路的样子真难看。
